title: A part sale's status card shows in full
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Part Sale Card" (used by this case only) with one contact.
  • One part sale [PS-1] for that customer with one part.

Setup

  1. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Part Sale Card" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  2. Click Parts in the top menu > Part Sales > New Part Sale > Customer: type and pick "ZZAUTOTEST Part Sale Card" (add it first with Customers > New Customer if missing) > Save (if a Confirmation about the credit limit appears, click Create). The part sale page opens; record the number at the top left as [PS-1] (the expected results call it "PS-1001").
  3. On the Parts tab click Add Part > Description "Brake Pads" > Quantity 1 > Category Uncategorized > Vendor: pick any > Cost 100 > Sell Price 290.91 > Save & Close.
  4. Check the setup worked: Parts > Part Sales > Search [PS-1] lists it as Estimate with Parts 1.
custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Part Sales.
  2. Click the [PS-1] row in the Part Sales list to open it.
  3. Read the status card at the left of the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The status card shows the part sale's status and its people fields (e.g. Sales Representative or technician) with their values, with no empty box, missing field or error message. Write down the fields you see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 5; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), Frontend screens; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 5: “The detail page's status card had props removed. Check that it renders and that changing the technician works.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
